A.name: Stack A: High-Throughput Sovereign Broadcast
A.tagline: Listmonk manages millions of contacts at $0 tax, Reacher scrubs bounces, Mailpit QAs HTML renders, Stalwart sends authenticated DKIM/DMARC mail.

B.name: Stack B: Visual Newsletter & Behavioral Lifecycle
B.tagline: Keila designs visual block newsletters, Roundcube manages warm replies, n8n automates behavioral drips, Adminer runs instant SQL segmentation.

listmonk.name: Listmonk
listmonk.role: High-speed Go self-hosted newsletter & broadcast engine (zero contact tax)
listmonk.first_run: Log in with 'admin' and the generated LISTMONK_ADMIN_PASSWORD in tools/listmonk/.env.

stalwart.name: Stalwart Mail Server
stalwart.role: Modern Rust all-in-one self-hosted SMTP/JMAP/DKIM/DMARC mail server
stalwart.first_run: Open the web admin console on :6110; check container logs for the initial generated admin password.

mailpit.name: Mailpit QA Sandbox
mailpit.role: Local SMTP capture, HTML rendering & link/spam QA before live blasts
mailpit.first_run: Point Listmonk test SMTP to host.docker.internal:1025 to inspect rendered emails safely before blasting.

reacher.name: Reacher Email Verifier
reacher.role: Self-hosted Rust MX/SMTP email verification API keeping bounce rates <1%
reacher.first_run: POST JSON {"to_email":"lead@domain.com"} to http://localhost:6130/v0/check_email for instant verification.

keila.name: Keila
keila.role: Visual block-editor Mailchimp/ConvertKit alternative with segments & forms
keila.first_run: Log in with admin@techstarz101.local and KEILA_USER_PASSWORD from tools/keila/.env.

roundcube.name: Roundcube Webmail
roundcube.role: Self-hosted reply inbox for managing warm newsletter & campaign responses
roundcube.first_run: Connects via IMAP/SMTP to Stalwart or your custom domain mailbox for unified reply handling.

n8n-email.name: n8n Email Automator
n8n-email.role: Behavioral drip sequences, bounce webhook handling & CRM subscriber sync

adminer.name: Adminer SQL Studio
adminer.role: Instant SQL audience segmentation & subscriber database management UI
adminer.first_run: Lightweight zero-config SQL UI to query, segment, and export subscriber lists directly from Postgres.
